sourceReceipts.title: Robotics special: Records tumble at China's World Humanoid Robot Games
sourceReceipts.notes: Current daily check. The edition is an attributed roundup, not primary authority. Its most dramatic robot-performance comparison did not resolve to an accessible official result, and its depot-work example routes through secondary reporting. It is retained only as a weak signal that physical-AI demonstrations and real workplace readiness must be separated. It does not establish safety, productivity, job or worker outcomes and is not a recommendation.

It is not authority for the transaction. Current NVIDIA, Hugging Face and regulatory checks still did not recover an exact company or regulatory announcement, so the acquisition claim remains HOLD.

sourceReceipts.title: Anthropic's $30 trillion market claim
sourceReceipts.notes: Bounded archive review. The useful distinct item is the newsletter's advice to make Gemini in Sheets show the selected range, supporting rows or cells, analysis steps and proposed action before accepting it. The current product mechanics were checked against Google's official help page. The newsletter's market and IPO claims were not admitted as facts.

sourceReceipts.title: Collaborate with Gemini in Google Sheets
sourceReceipts.notes: Google documents Gemini in Sheets for eligible plans, recommends native Sheets data, exposes Analysis steps, previews charts and proposed actions before Apply, and supports Undo. Google also notes that a generated chart is not linked to the original data and does not update automatically. These are current provider-primary product mechanics, not evidence that the model's analysis is correct for a representative reader task.

opportunities.title: Make spreadsheet AI show the evidence before it changes the sheet
opportunities.readerValue: Readers can use Gemini in Sheets without treating a confident analysis as a verdict: define the real range, inspect the steps and supporting cells, preview the proposed change and approve only what checks out.
opportunities.facts: Google documents Gemini in Sheets for eligible plans, Analysis steps, chart previews, action preview cards, Apply and Undo. Google also says generated charts are not linked to later changes in the original data.
opportunities.attributedInterpretation: The Neuron frames the technique as making Gemini show its work in Sheets.
opportunities.laidiesInference: This is a distinct productivity and judgment job for Paige because it improves how a reader reviews AI-assisted data work rather than merely lengthening a prompt. The product controls make review possible; they do not prove the analysis is correct.
